verdict.rationale: iTerm2 ships a well-documented Python API for scripting/automation, corroborated by hands-on community praise ('basically AppleScript for iTerm except it lets you touch pretty much everything'), plus AppleScript support as an alternative programmatic interface. Missing for 10: no OpenAPI/REST spec or llms.txt (probes 404), and no evidence of a modern machine-readable API spec beyond the Python/AppleScript docs.
